tutorial.complete: You're ready! Good luck out there.

step.alliance_info: Allies can't attack each other. You can break an alliance at any time — but doing so marks you as a traitor.
step.attack_nations: Lords have cut you off from the Barons. Attack a neighboring Lord instead — they're stronger than Barons, so bring plenty of troops. The nearest ones are marked with a target. Conquer them until you have {cost} gold for a Population Center.
step.attack_ratio: The attack ratio bar sets how many of your troops are sent out with each attack. Drag the slider to adjust it.
step.attack_wilderness: The pulsing ring marks your territory. Click on the unclaimed nebula next to it to attack and expand.
step.buy_city: You can afford a Population Center! Press {key} (or click the Population Center icon under the control panel), then click your territory to place it. Population Centers raise your max troops.
step.buy_defense_post: Now build a Defense Post: press {key}, then click your territory near a border. Attacks on the nebula around it are much slower and cost the enemy far more troops.
step.buy_factory: Now build an Industrial Zone: press {key}, then click your territory to place it.
step.buy_port: Next, build a Spaceport: press {key}, then click anywhere in your territory to place it. Its ships put to space at the nearest deep space.
step.buy_stargate: Now build a Stargate: press {key}, then click your territory to place it. A gate fires your troops through space at any tile in its range, and is also your warhead launcher.
step.buy_warship: Now build a Destroyer: press {key}, then click deep space near your spaceport. Destroyers capture freighters and guard your space.
step.capture_tribes: Capturing Barons is a great way to earn gold — the nearest ones are marked with a target on the map. Conquer them until you have {cost} gold for a Population Center.
step.dark_star: The disc at the centre of the map is the Dark Star, held by the Hegemon. The round ends when the Hegemon is eliminated or the timer runs out, and whoever takes its last tile wins and holds the throne next round. Build up first: it is far stronger than it looks.
step.earn_gold: Attack neighbors to steal their nebulae, conquer them to take their gold. You need {cost} to build the {unit}.
step.factory_info: Industrial Zones form a trade network with nearby population centers, spaceports and other industrial zones, and send supply deliveries along it that earn you gold.
step.fire_gate: Your gate is ready! Right-click a tile in its range that is not yours, open the stargate menu and pick the sword, Gate shot. The shot lands and fights like a fleet, and the nebula is kept.
step.gate_loading: Your Stargate is building or reloading. A shot can be fired once it is ready.
step.invade_info_slot: To win, land on the Dark Star by fleet across the moat or by gate shot. Only one invader at a time may hold tiles there, and if your advance stalls for {stall} seconds the throne's whole income is sent against you.
step.invade_info_win: Take the Hegemon's last tile and you win the round and the throne. Other players can reinforce the throne with troops, so bring more than you think you need.
step.no_coast: You have no coastline yet. Reaching deep space matters — it lets you send fleets and launch destroyers. Spaceports work anywhere, but their freighters crawl overland until they reach it. Expand your territory until it touches deep space.
step.port_info_ships: Spaceports send out freighters, which earn you gold.
step.port_info_warships: Spaceports also let you launch destroyers.
step.propose_alliance: Lords make strong allies. Right-click the Lord marked with a target and propose an alliance.
step.send_boat: Fleets carry your troops across deep space. Right-click enemy territory on the far side of deep space to open the radial menu, then select the fleet.
step.shield_info: Shield Array: a dome of {shield} tiles that no other player's warhead can harm the inside of, the Hegemon's included. The blast still clears the ground outside it. It keeps out warheads only: the Hegemon's strikes and every Stargate shot pass straight through.
step.spawn: Click anywhere on the map to pick where you spawn.
step.spawn_wait: Spot picked! You can still move it until the timer runs out — the game starts then.
step.strike_info: The Hegemon cannot expand, but it can strike: a strike flies from the Dark Star, lands on your nebula and razes it. The nebula it holds is its bubble.
step.strike_info_counter: Fight it with Counter-attack in the attacks panel, or by clicking the bubble: your troops cancel the strike's, and the moment it stops advancing it ends. Nebula it has taken is lost, and it can never eliminate you.
step.traitor_info: Traitors get a large defense debuff for 30 seconds, so be careful.
step.troop_rate: This is your troop growth rate. Growth slows down and turns orange once your troops approach half of your max.
step.troops: Keep an eye on your troop count. Attacking with too few troops leaves you weak — let them regrow between attacks.
step.warhead_info_launch: Nuclear and Antimatter Warheads launch from a ready gate whose range covers the target.
step.warhead_info_punish: A launch flags the gate for {flag} seconds: the Hegemon may answer with a punitive strike, paid for by a levy on every player's troops, yours included.

step_touch.attack_wilderness: The pulsing ring marks your territory. Tap the unclaimed nebula next to it, then tap the sword in the middle of the menu to attack.
step_touch.buy_city: You can afford a Population Center! Tap your territory, open the wrench (Build) menu and pick Population Center. Population Centers raise your max troops.
step_touch.buy_defense_post: Now build a Defense Post: tap your territory near a border, open the wrench menu and pick Defense Post. Attacks on the nebula around it are much slower and cost the enemy far more troops.
step_touch.buy_factory: Now build an Industrial Zone: tap your territory, open the wrench menu and pick Industrial Zone.
step_touch.buy_port: Next, build a Spaceport: tap anywhere in your territory, open the wrench menu and pick Spaceport.
step_touch.buy_stargate: Now build a Stargate: tap your territory, open the wrench menu and pick Stargate. A gate fires your troops through space at any tile in its range, and is also your warhead launcher.
step_touch.buy_warship: Now build a Destroyer: tap deep space near your spaceport, open the stargate menu and pick Destroyer. Destroyers capture freighters and guard your space.
step_touch.fire_gate: Your gate is ready! Tap a tile in its range that is not yours, open the stargate menu and pick the sword, Gate shot. The shot lands and fights like a fleet, and the nebula is kept.
step_touch.propose_alliance: Lords make strong allies. Tap the Lord marked with a target, then tap the handshake to propose an alliance.
step_touch.send_boat: Fleets carry your troops across deep space. Tap enemy territory on the far side of deep space to open the radial menu, then select the fleet.
step_touch.spawn: Tap anywhere on the map to pick where you spawn.
